# CodePipelineProcessStatus

Where a code pipeline run is.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"New"` | Waiting for a worker to pick the run up, after it is started or resumed. |
| `"Running"` | The agents are working. |
| `"Finished"` | The run finished. |
| `"Error"` | The run failed or timed out: see `failureDetails` and `failureReason`. It can be resumed. |
| `"Killed"` | Someone stopped the run. It can be resumed. |
| `"HumanInteractionRequired"` | An agent asked a question: answer it to carry on. |
| `"HumanInteractionComplete"` | Every question is answered and the run is waiting for a worker to carry on. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodePipelineProcess`](code-pipeline-process.md)
- Inside [`CodePipelineProcessUpdatedSummary`](code-pipeline-process-updated-summary.md)
